supplemental_object_scan.scope: All reachable Git blobs, gzip contents and zip members
supplemental_object_scan.method: Read Git objects without executing them; scan literal credential and Base64 variants plus private-key, provider-token and credential-assignment patterns; decompress gzip and ZIP members.

limitations: Pattern scans cannot prove absence of every possible secret.
Local Git hooks require activation in each clone and can be bypassed; CI runs after a push.
Previously exposed credentials, if discovered, require revocation even after history cleanup.
